scenario.title: 聊世代差異和懷舊
scenario.context: 聊世代差異時，常會出現「真希望…」：真希望我年輕十歲、真希望當年有智慧型手機、真希望爸媽能理解。英文的 wish 和 if only 後面的時態要「往過去退一格」，跟第 45、64 單元的條件句是同一套邏輯。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: My mom still prints out emails to read them.
lines.zh: 我媽還是會把 email 印出來看。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: That's so old school. My dad calls instead of texting.
lines.zh: 好老派。我爸都打電話不傳訊息。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I wish my parents understood what I do for work.
lines.zh: 真希望我爸媽懂我在做什麼工作。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Same. Mine think freelancing means unemployed.
lines.zh: 我也是。我爸媽以為接案就是失業。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Back in the day, they say, everyone had a stable job for life.
lines.zh: 他們說以前的年代，每個人都有一輩子的鐵飯碗。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: If only it were that simple now.
lines.zh: 要是現在也那麼簡單就好了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Right? I wish I had known about freelancing when I was in college.
lines.zh: 對吧？真希望我大學時就知道接案這件事。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: My intern said my presentation was "bussin, no cap." What does that mean?
lines.zh: 我的實習生說我的簡報「bussin, no cap」，那是什麼意思？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Ha! "No cap" means "no lie." It's a compliment.
lines.zh: 哈！No cap 是「不騙你」的意思，那是稱讚。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I wish I could keep up with their slang.
lines.zh: 真希望我跟得上他們的用語。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Don't try too hard, though. If you use it wrong, they'll roast you.
lines.zh: 不過別太努力，用錯的話他們會嘲笑你。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I know. When I complained about TikTok, one of them said "OK boomer."
lines.zh: 我知道。我抱怨 TikTok 時，其中一個人說「OK boomer」。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Ouch. And you're not even a boomer!
lines.zh: 好痛。而且你根本不是嬰兒潮世代！

patterns.en: I wish I had ___ when I was younger.
Every generation thinks the next one is lazy.
patterns.zh: 每一代都覺得下一代很懶。

chinglish.why: 不可能實現的願望用 wish + 過去式，hope 是用在「有可能」的事。

chinglish.wrong: I wish I know the answer.
chinglish.right: I wish I knew the answer.
chinglish.why: wish 後面講現在的事要用過去式。

chinglish.wrong: I wish I studied harder in college.
chinglish.right: I wish I had studied harder in college.
chinglish.why: 對過去的遺憾用 had + p.p.。

chinglish.wrong: The generation gap between us is very big.
chinglish.right: We have a big generation gap. / We see things very differently.
chinglish.why: 文法沒錯，但口語更常說「我們看法不同」。

grammar.title: wish / if only
grammar.oneLiner: wish / if only 表達不可能實現的願望：現在的事用過去式，過去的事用 had + p.p.，希望別人改變用 would。
whenToUse: 現在的遺憾：wish + 過去式。I wish I knew. / I wish I were taller.
過去的遺憾：wish + had + p.p.。I wish I had studied harder.
希望別人或情況改變：wish + would。I wish my dad would text instead of calling.
能力：wish + could。I wish I could speak Japanese.
if only 意思相同但更強烈：If only I had known!
hope 用在有可能的事：I hope you get the job.（不是 wish）
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「希望」同時代表 hope（可能實現）和 wish（不可能實現），而且動詞不變。英文不只要選對字，wish 後面還要往過去退一格。台灣人常說 I wish I know 或 I hope I am taller，聽起來邏輯很奇怪。

examples.correct: I wish I had more free time.
examples.incorrect: I wish I have more free time.

examples.correct: I wish I had bought that apartment ten years ago.
examples.note: 過去的遺憾用 had + p.p.。

examples.correct: I wish you would stop checking your phone at dinner.
If only I could go back in time!
I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow.
examples.incorrect: I wish it doesn't rain tomorrow.

quiz.question: I wish I ___ how to fix this.
quiz.explanation: 現在的遺憾：wish + 過去式。

quiz.question: I wish I ___ harder when I was in school.
I wish my neighbors ___ stop playing loud music. (希望別人改變)
I ___ you have a great trip!
If only I ___ (be) ten years younger!

slang.usage: 形容傳統的做法、風格或人。可以是「過時」，也可以是「經典有味道」。

risk.note: 看語氣可能是稱讚也可能是調侃。

examples.en: My boss is old school. He wants everything printed.
examples.zh: 我老闆很老派，什麼都要印出來。

examples.en: Back in the day, we had to use maps instead of GPS.
examples.zh: 以前我們都要用地圖，沒有 GPS。

examples.en: Back in the day, this street was all rice fields.
examples.zh: 想當年這條街都是稻田。

slang.usage: cap = 說謊。No cap = 我沒在唬爛。源自非裔美國人英語（AAVE），Gen Z 大量使用。

risk.note: Gen Z 用語，年紀較大的人用會顯得刻意，職場避免。聽懂就好。

examples.en: This is the best ramen in Taipei, no cap.
examples.zh: 這是台北最好吃的拉麵，說真的。

examples.en: No cap, I finished the whole series in one day.
examples.zh: 不騙你，我一天就追完整部劇。

slang.meaning: 好啦老人家（嘲諷上一代的保守觀念）
slang.usage: 年輕世代用來回應長輩說教的反諷用語。boomer 指嬰兒潮世代（1946–1964 出生）。

risk.note: 非常失禮，帶年齡歧視意味，對長輩或同事說會嚴重冒犯。只需要聽得懂。

examples.en: He complained about young people being lazy, and someone replied, "OK boomer."
examples.zh: 他抱怨年輕人懶，有人回「好啦老人家」。

examples.en: The phrase "OK boomer" went viral in 2019.
examples.zh: 「OK boomer」這個說法在 2019 年爆紅。

review.question: I heard my parents ___ about my job.
___ young people spend a lot of time online.
review.explanation: 複習第 66 單元：泛指複數不加冠詞。

review.question: If my parents ___ (have) smartphones, they would have texted more.
My dad ___ work at a factory, but now he's retired.
My parents will ___ never understand TikTok.
"I don't get it." → My mom said she ___ get it.
review.explanation: 複習第 36 單元：轉述時態後退。

review.question: When I was a kid, we ___ (play) outside every day.
review.explanation: 複習第 4 單元：過去式。
